heroTitle: A Space to Regain Inner Clarity,
heroLead: Confidential, tailored support through burnout, anxiety, emotional overload, and complex life transitions, for individuals and couples.
reachLine: In German and English, for clients in Switzerland and internationally.

heroPortrait.alt: Theresa Frische, smiling, in a bright room with a plant behind her.

heroParas: Sometimes life keeps moving while something inside no longer feels right. Outwardly, you may be functioning, while inwardly navigating exhaustion, restlessness, or a quiet sense of losing touch with yourself.
I guide individuals and couples through emotionally demanding times, helping you regulate your nervous system, break through entrenched patterns, and reconnect with what truly matters to you.
heroEmphasis: This work is not about fixing what is broken. It is about creating a reflective space to better understand yourself and move toward a life aligned with your values.

trustPillars.title: Discreet
trustPillars.body: A protected, judgment-free space — for what usually finds no room elsewhere.

trustPillars.title: Evidence-based
trustPillars.body: Scientifically grounded methods, carefully tailored to you.

trustPillars.title: Flexible
trustPillars.body: Support that adapts to your life — not the other way around.

testimonials.text: Theresa creates a space that feels safe, grounded, and deeply supportive. Through her guidance I've become more resilient, more present — and more myself again.
What moved me most was how authentically present Theresa is as a person. Her body-oriented approach helped me feel and understand my emotions again.

testimonial.text: Theresa creates a space that feels safe, grounded, and deeply supportive. Through her guidance I've become more resilient, more present — and more myself again.

audience.heading: Who this space is for
audience.intro: For people at meaningful crossroads — when the old no longer holds, and the new isn't tangible yet.

items.title: Life Transitions
items.body: Relocation, separation, career change, loss, becoming a parent — changes that ask for deep inner adjustment and emotional adaptation.

items.title: Identity & Orientation
items.body: Periods of uncertainty, reorientation, and questions of meaning, purpose, and life direction.

items.title: Overwhelm & Burnout
items.body: Recognising the early signs of burnout, regulating sustained stress, and finding your way back to connection and balance.

items.title: Emotional & Nervous System Regulation
items.body: Working with worry, inner restlessness, and physical stress responses — and with emotional experiences too heavy to carry alone.

items.title: Relationship Challenges & Couples
items.body: Moving through entrenched patterns, easing emotional distance, improving communication, and resolving conflict constructively.

items.title: Expat & International Life
items.body: What it means to live between countries, cultures, and shifting social worlds. Counselling for expats and international couples in English and German — working online with people in Switzerland, Germany and beyond.

pauseBand.text: There is no single way through. What matters is that you do not have to work it out on your own.

steps.heading: Systemic. Somatic. Integrative.
steps.intro: I combine evidence-based methods with an integrative stance and deep respect for each person's individual story and inner resources.

modalities.heading: Modalities I draw from
modalities.note: I draw on these approaches within psychological counselling. I do not offer psychotherapy and I am not a psychotherapist.

steps.closing: Psychological counselling is a shared process. You remain the expert on your own life; I accompany you with professional expertise, empathy, and fresh perspectives.

aboutBlock.heading: I'm Theresa Frische
aboutBlock.body: With a Master of Science in Clinical Psychology and further training in systemic counselling, somatic approaches and mindfulness, I support individuals and couples through emotionally challenging times and meaningful life transitions.

items.title: Complete Discretion & Privacy
items.body: No diagnoses in health-insurance records. No reporting to any insurer — what's discussed stays confidential.

items.title: Fast Access
items.body: We begin as soon as you're ready — no doctor's referral, no waiting time through an insurer.

items.title: Maximum Flexibility
items.body: Location-independent online, in English and German — for a life that spans more than one country. Sessions are online, and in person in Zug by arrangement.

practical.heading: Working together

items.label: Format
items.value: Online, and in person in Zug by arrangement

practical.closing: Ready to take the first step? Book a free 15-minute discovery call — a relaxed, no-obligation way to begin.
